# @nestjs-redisx/cache

> 标签: cache, invalidation, l1, l2, nestjs, redis, stampede, swr, tags

## 简介

Advanced caching plugin for NestJS RedisX with L1+L2, anti-stampede, SWR, and tag invalidation

## 官网

- 官网：https://nestjs-redisx.dev/en/reference/cache/
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/nestjs-redisx/nestjs-redisx.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nestjs-redisx/cache
